plan.title: [AppSec] HIGH subprocess-scm-01: Unvalidated deliveryBranch is passed to git fetch as a raw refspec/option

narratives.Description: [AppSec] HIGH subprocess-scm-01: Unvalidated deliveryBranch is passed to git fetch as a raw refspec/option
narratives.Overview:
## Bound remedy (#5364 Prefer-A 6050389462)

1. Shared fail-closed branch-name gate with closed grammar (no leading dash, colon, .., controls, spaces, @{}, .lock); do not equate check-ref-format success with that grammar.
2. Sink-scoped gate at every policy reader and argv builder (resolveDeliveryBranch, resolveBaseBranch, parseTypedPolicyBranches, CLI twins). Invalid present policy is terminal configuration error before fetch/worktree/proof.
3. Replace bare git fetch origin <branch> with allowed form only: git fetch origin -- refs/heads/<validated>:<dest-ref> coupled to tip readers consume.
4. Keep private-dest fetch but gate interpolated branch before either side of refspec.
5. Closed call-site inventory under this Bound (finalize-cohort, origin-active-brief, delivery-evidence, finalize-owed, generation-gate, branch-sync, sync-default/max-files, live-procedure-targets, worktree tip forms).
6. Tests: upload-pack, colon rewrite, leading dash including check-ref-format exit-0 cases, .., @{}, empty/whitespace, invalid typed policy terminal refuse, happy-path main/master/release/x, private-dest tip coupling.
Reject B-F.

narrative.Acceptance: Add shared fail-closed branch-name gate with explicit closed grammar: no leading dash, no colon, no .., no ASCII controls, no spaces, no @{, no .lock suffix; reject literal input rather than expand revision shorthand. Do not equate git check-ref-format refs/heads/<input> exit 0 with that grammar.

items.title: Sink-scoped gate at policy readers and argv builders

narrative.Acceptance: Apply the gate at every policy reader and argv builder, not only resolveDeliveryBranch: include resolveBaseBranch, parseTypedPolicyBranches (remote-blob reader in branch-sync), CLI delivery-branch / twin base-branch paths, and helpers that build git argv from those strings. Invalid present policy is a terminal configuration error before fetch/worktree/proof, not default-on-error fallback.

items.title: Safe fetch argv form with tip coupling

narrative.Acceptance: Replace bare git fetch origin <branch> with allowed form only: git fetch origin -- refs/heads/<validated>:<dest-ref> (tracking or private dest) that places -- before the refspec and couples the dest-side ref to what later readers consume (origin/<branch> refresh or returned immutable tip OID).
Keep private-dest fetch (fetchDeliveryTipPrivate / generationFetchArgs) but gate the interpolated branch before building either side of the refspec.

Gate or convert closed inventory call sites under this Bound including finalize-cohort deliveryBranch/baseBranch fetches, origin-active-brief, delivery-evidence, finalize-owed private fetch, generation-gate args, branch-sync source/prBase fetches, sync-default/sync-max-files dest/source fetches, live-procedure-targets depth-1 fetch token, and worktree tip forms fed by the same strings.

Tests before spawn: --upload-pack=..., colon rewrite toward master/main, leading dash including cases where prefixed check-ref-format would exit 0, .., @{}, empty/whitespace, invalid typed policy terminal refuse (no silent default), happy-path main/master/release/x; plus regression where old origin tracking tip differs from fetched delivery tip when private-dest form is used.

AppSec remediation - Product: Directive (`deftai/directive`) - Finding: `subprocess-scm-01` - Severity: high - Scan: 2026-10-05 @ `d855dc0f784a24ed6d99cffd488a85f41d22431c` - Report: [2026-10-05 AppSec report § directive / subprocess-scm-01](https://github.com/deftai/appsec-scans/blob/3dd35fd7f6b54922c56759157c13c821b4374dec/reports/directive/2026-10-05/report.md#directive-subprocess-scm-01) ### Impact A committed PROJECT-DEFINITION (or CLI `--delivery-branch` when policy is untyped) can make swarm finalize/launch run `git fetch origin --upload-pack=...` or `git fetch origin refs/heads/attacker:refs/heads/master`, rewriting local default-branch refs or, on local/SSH remotes, executing a caller-chosen upload-pack.
Agents routinely invoke these verbs after ingesting repo policy.
Remediation Reject `deliveryBranch` unless it matches a closed git `check-ref-format` grammar (no leading `-`, no `:`, no `..`, no control chars).
Fetch only as `git fetch origin -- refs/heads/<branch>` (or a private dest ref as in `fetchDeliveryTipPrivate`).
Apply the same gate to `worktree add` / `ls-tree` / `show` arguments.
Filed by the scheduled AppSec scan.
Do not close until the control is in the default branch.
The next weekly scan will comment here if this ID is still confirmed.
